panels.title: Stacking: Off
panels.description: Stacking Off (the default): the series draw side by side.

panels.title: Stacking: Normal
panels.description: Stacking Normal: one stack per category. Negative values stack below zero.

panels.title: Stacking: 100%
panels.description: Stacking 100%: each stack fills the axis; the labels show each share.

panels.title: Stacking override: off for one field
panels.description: Stacking Normal, and the field override Stacking Off on Target: Target draws beside the stack.

panels.title: Stacking: two time queries
panels.description: Stacking Normal on a time axis from two queries with different timestamps. The stacks join on time.

panels.title: Orientation: Auto (tall panel)
panels.description: Orientation Auto: the panel is taller than wide, so the bars are horizontal.

panels.title: Orientation: Horizontal
panels.description: Orientation Horizontal: the first category at the top.

panels.title: Orientation: Vertical (tall panel)
panels.description: Orientation Vertical keeps the bars upright in a tall panel.

panels.title: Show values: Auto
panels.description: Show values Auto (the default): the bars are labeled, and labels that overlap are hidden.

panels.title: Show values: Always
panels.description: Show values Always: every bar is labeled.

panels.title: Show values: Never
panels.description: Show values Never: no labels.

panels.title: Negative values
panels.description: The label of a negative bar is below the bar end.

panels.title: Text size: Value 22
panels.description: Text size > Value = 22 sets the label size. Unset fits the bars.

panels.title: Unit and decimals
panels.description: The labels use the field unit and decimals (currencyUSD, 1 decimal).

panels.title: Bar fill opacity: 30
panels.description: Bar fill opacity 30. The border stays solid.

panels.title: Line width: 3
panels.description: Line width 3: the bar border width. The default is 1.

panels.title: Line width: 0
panels.description: Line width 0: no bar border.

panels.title: Bar radius: 8
panels.description: Bar radius 8 px on the value end. A stack rounds its top bar only.

panels.title: Bar width: 40%
panels.description: Bar width 40% of the category.

panels.title: Color scheme: From thresholds
panels.description: Color scheme From thresholds: each bar takes the color of its threshold step.

panels.title: Value mappings with color
panels.description: A range mapping 0 to 110 colors those bars purple; the other bars keep the series color.

panels.title: Color by field
panels.description: Color by field = Score. Each Sales bar takes the Score color (thresholds) of its row.

panels.title: Axis: Soft min and max
panels.description: Soft min 50 and soft max 200 extend the axis.

panels.title: Axis: Min and Max
panels.description: Min 90 and Max 140 fix the axis; a bar axis otherwise starts at zero.

panels.title: Axis: Scale Logarithmic
panels.description: Scale Logarithmic, base 10.

panels.title: Axis: Centered zero
panels.description: Centered zero: the axis is symmetric around 0.

panels.title: Axis: Label
panels.description: Axis label = Spend.

panels.title: Axis: Show grid lines Off
panels.description: Show grid lines Off.

panels.title: Axis: Color Series
panels.description: Axis color Series: the tick labels take the series color.

panels.title: Axis: Show border
panels.description: Show border draws the axis line.

panels.title: Axis: Width 30
panels.description: Axis width 30 cuts long tick labels.

panels.title: Axis: Placement Right
panels.description: Placement Right.

panels.title: Axis: Placement Hidden
panels.description: Placement Hidden: no value axis, the bars still draw.

panels.title: Transform: Negative Y
panels.description: Transform Negative Y on Loss: it draws below zero, and its labels keep the field value.

panels.title: X tick rotation and max length
panels.description: X tick rotation -45 and max length 10 characters (Advanced).

panels.title: Tooltip: All
panels.description: Tooltip mode All lists every series at the hovered category.

panels.title: Highlight full area on hover
panels.description: Highlight full area on hover draws a band over the hovered category.

panels.title: Hide in area: Legend
panels.description: Actual has Hide in area > Legend: it draws, but has no legend item.

panels.title: Hide in area: Tooltip
panels.description: Actual has Hide in area > Tooltip, with tooltip mode All: its row is not in the tooltip.
